messages:
emily: Drafting release notes for the docs site; aiming for deploy tomorrow EOD. Please check SDK snippets, migration checklist, and known-issues bullets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102
raj: Taking SDK snippets. I'll run the TS sample locally and update the client initializer.
marco: I'll handle migration guide bullets 8 breaking changes + rollback suggestions.
olivia: On link sweep. Found an external model-card link 404 on the embeddings page 8 will open redirect or update to archived model card.
docs-bot: PR 1102 status: docs build passed, 3 TODO comments remain.
emily: TODOs: 1) streaming behavior note for embeddings endpoint, 2) update SDK snippet for new client options, 3) add known-issue for quantized tokenization drift.
raj: FYI, TS client now accepts "region" and "prefetchCache". Current snippet shows old signature. I'll push a minimal patch.
raj: Old snippet: ```js
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY})
```
raj: Updated snippet: ```js
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'us-west-2', prefetchCache: true})
```
marco: I'll add a concise table for the migration guide: param | old behavior | new behavior | mitigation. Pushing branch mg/migration-table.
olivia: Anchor/redirect report:
- /docs/embeddings/index: external model-card link 404
- /docs/sdk/ts: anchor mismatch client-opts -> client-options
I can open redirects for external and patch internal anchor.
emily: Known-issue draft: "Quantized K-Formats: tokenization drift observed on v1.3 quantized builds for long prefix prompts. Workaround: route to non-quantized variant or shorten prefix caching window."
jen: Suggest action wording: "Workaround: route affected requests to the non-quantized model variant or reduce prefix length. Tracked in issue #457."
emily: Good, I'll link GH issue.
marco: Also note Dedicated customers might see different latency distributions for model variants; include brief note under Performance section.
raj: Opened PR 1103 to patch TS snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1103
docs-bot: PR 1103 opened by raj 8 checks queued.
emily: If 1103 merges and link fixes + migration table are merged, we can ship docs tomorrow. Flag blockers here by 17:00 PT.
olivia: Anchorcheck pass in progress; I'll push fixes by noon PT.
marco: PR 1104 created for migration table and perf note on branch mg/migration-table.
jen: I'll proof known-issues and the release blurb after 3pm PT. Light pass only.
emily: Final checklist: [x] TS snippet fix (raj), [x] link fixes & redirects (olivia), [x] migration table draft (marco), [ ] known-issues blurb final proof (jen), [x] CI green on main.
raj: Merged PR 1103; TS sample updated in branch.
docs-bot: PR 1103 merged. Build queued and passed.
olivia: Anchorcheck complete; pushed internal anchor fix and opened 2 redirects.
jen: Reviewed known-issue blurb; one minor wording tweak. Approving release blurb.
emily: Posting release in #marketing in ~10m and queuing docs deploy. Ping me if anything else changes. :rocket:
